destination.name: Griffith
destination.tagline: A Riverina irrigation town known for Italian food and wine, with a rugged range park nearby.
destination.description: Griffith is the main town of the Murrumbidgee Irrigation Area, and its Pioneer Park Museum tells how irrigation and Italian migrants shaped it. The town is known for Italian food, especially gnocchi, and several of Australia's biggest wine companies, including De Bortoli, McWilliams and Casella, are based here, with some cellar doors open for tastings. About 25 km north-east, Cocoparra National Park has ridge walks and waterfalls after rain.
whyVisit: Walk the ridges of Cocoparra National Park
Trace irrigation history at Pioneer Park Museum
Taste Italian food and local wine

goodToKnow.title: Check Cocoparra first
goodToKnow.detail: The park can close for weather or fire danger, and the waterfalls only run after rain.

goodToKnow.title: Museum hours and price
goodToKnow.detail: Griffith Pioneer Park Museum is open daily: Mon–Fri 10 am–4 pm, Sat–Sun 10 am–3 pm, about $15 entry.

goodToKnow.title: August Italian festival
goodToKnow.detail: An annual Italian food festival is held in August, when the town is busiest for dining.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} avoid summers that can reach 47 °C and suit the Cocoparra walks and cellar-door visits.
